description: A role's interface: argument_specs entry points and options (no_log honoured), defaults with redacted values, which defaults are undocumented, dependencies, vars names and galaxy_info. Works for local roles (roles_path, dir/roles, or a path) and collection roles (ns.collection.role).

description_chars.description: Truncate each description to this many characters; 0 = no limit (default 160)

dir.description: Ansible project directory. Default: ANSIBLE_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

role.description: Local role name, path relative to dir, or ns.collection.role

name: ansible_role_interface
title: Role interface
